party: 5 travellers, ONE booking per stop: a 2-bedroom unit, or 2 rooms (2+3 adults)
read_only_confirmation: Compiled from public pages and the private evidence file on 2026-10-04. No rate in this file was invented: every cost range is a line-by-line build whose dated lines are named in cost_basis, and the rest are estimates. No budget figure appears here — whether a range fits is decided at render time against the configured budget.
notes: legs are (origin, destination) airport pairs with no dates: the dates are derived at render time from the report's own priceable date pair, so a search link always matches the trip being priced.
cabin is what the engine prices for these routes (all of them are over eight hours from London, so BUSINESS).
confidence is 'dated-rate' only where a dated public rate or fare backs the figure, 'estimate' where every line is a build.

itineraries.title: Bali 7 nights + Lombok 7 nights

stops.hotel: 2-bedroom villa, B&B (no dated Bali rate was readable — pick one on the property's own engine)
Kalandara Resort Lombok — AKASA 2-bedroom pool villa stated for 5
stops.basis: dated rate, Google Hotels, 7 nights from 20 Jul 2027

itineraries.flight_shape: open-jaw: London to Bali, home from Lombok. One internal hop of under an hour, about 11 flights a day (Lion Air, Citilink, Garuda, Batik Air). NOT PRICED as an open-jaw — no dated multi-city fare was readable.
itineraries.cost_basis: built line by line; the only dated line is the Lombok villa (GBP 376 x 7). Flights, the Bali half and transfers are estimates.
itineraries.why: the only pairing where a real 2-bedroom unit for 5 carries a dated price, and Lombok is 50 minutes from Bali so no day is lost
itineraries.catch: the Bali half is entirely an estimate, and the two stops use different food models

itineraries.title: Khao Lak 7 nights + Koh Phangan 7 nights

stops.hotel: Pullman Khao Lak Resort — Family Suite for 3 plus a Deluxe Room for 2, one booking
stops.basis: dated rate: GBP 1,141.42 for 7 nights B&B, both rooms

stops.hotel: Anantara Rasananda Two Bedroom Pool Villa stated for 5 — Panviman is the cheaper option but its 2-bedroom unit for 5 is unverified
stops.basis: dated nightly for Anantara at GBP 1,657, which pushes this pair over the ceiling whatever the ceiling is; the cheaper alternative is an estimate

itineraries.flight_shape: open-jaw into Phuket, home via Samui. Koh Phangan has NO airport: the repositioning is the Surat Thani ferry (about 5-6 hours with the road) or a flight into Samui and the 30-minute Lomprayah catamaran. NOT PRICED as an open-jaw.
itineraries.cost_basis: built line by line; two dated lines (the LHR-HKT fare for 5 and the Pullman 7-night total). The Phangan half is an estimate.
itineraries.why: the cheapest dated 5-person rate in the evidence, and one bag for two different islands
itineraries.catch: the second stop costs a ferry day, and July is the west-coast wet season

itineraries.title: Bangkok 3 nights + Koh Samui 7 nights + Khao Lak 7 nights

stops.hotel: two rooms or a suite for 5 on one booking, B&B (no dated rate was readable)
Garrya Tongsai Bay Samui — two Beachfront Suites (3+2 adults) in one 2-room search
stops.basis: dated rate: GBP 4,589.98 for 7 nights B&B

stops.hotel: Pullman Khao Lak Resort — Family Suite plus Deluxe Room, one booking
stops.basis: dated rate: GBP 1,141.42 for 7 nights B&B

itineraries.flight_shape: three-stop multi-city: Bangkok out and back, with Bangkok Airways on both island hops (about 1h05 and about 1h). NOT PRICED as a multi-city ticket — costed as two dated round trips, which OVER-states it by an open-jaw's worth.
itineraries.cost_basis: built line by line; four dated lines (both long-haul fares for 5 and both hotel totals). A single multi-city ticket would likely cut GBP 1,000-1,500 of flying.
itineraries.why: three genuinely different stops in 17 nights, on short daily domestic legs
itineraries.catch: three check-ins and two internal flights, even on dated rates

itineraries.title: Da Nang 7 nights + Hoi An 6 nights

stops.place: Da Nang (My Khe or Non Nuoc beach)
stops.hotel: a 2-bedroom villa or two connecting rooms for 5 on one booking (no dated rate was readable)

stops.place: Hoi An (An Bang beach, 15 km from the old town)
stops.hotel: 2-bedroom villa for 5, B&B (no dated rate was readable)

itineraries.flight_shape: a single round trip into Da Nang — Da Nang is the airport for BOTH stops, so this is the one pairing here with no internal travel leg at all. Hoi An is 30-45 minutes by road, twice.
itineraries.cost_basis: ALL estimate, including the flights — this is a shape, not a quote. Do not read it as a price.
itineraries.why: no internal flight and no airport change: the same flights as a single-centre trip
itineraries.catch: nothing in it is sourced, and July is Vietnam's wet season

itineraries.title: Tokyo 5 nights + Okinawa 7 nights

stops.hotel: two rooms or a 5-person suite, B&B (no dated rate was readable)
Halekulani Okinawa — 50 m² rooms with terrace, or one of five villas. A 5-adult single unit is NOT confirmed
stops.basis: estimate: an aggregator showed an undated "$288 nightly", which is not a rate for these dates

itineraries.flight_shape: multi-city: London to Tokyo, then ANA, JAL, Skymark or Solaseed to Naha (2h40, about 17 flights a day), home from Okinawa. No London nonstop to Okinawa exists; the whole journey is about 16h30 door to door. NOT PRICED.
itineraries.cost_basis: built line by line and nothing in it is priced — flights and both hotels are estimates.
itineraries.why: the strongest July weather case, and the only pairing with a real internal flight
itineraries.catch: nothing is priced, food for 5 is unbudgeted, and it is 16h30 from home

itineraries.title: Muscat 4 nights + Abu Dhabi or Dubai 4 nights

stops.hotel: InterContinental Muscat — two City View Balcony rooms (3+2 adults) in one 2-room search
stops.basis: dated rate: GBP 2,120-2,832 for 8 nights B&B

stops.hotel: two rooms or a 5-person suite, B&B (no dated rate was readable)

itineraries.flight_shape: open-jaw into Muscat, home from Abu Dhabi or Dubai, with a 1h15 hop between them on Etihad or Oman Air (up to four a day). NOT PRICED as an open-jaw.
itineraries.cost_basis: built line by line; the Muscat line is dated. This is the cheapest pairing in this research by a wide margin, with the most headroom — whether it fits the configured budget is decided at render time.
itineraries.why: the cheapest pairing here by far: two short-hop Gulf cities, warm in December
itineraries.catch: NOT a beach holiday — beach access, not a beach to lie on

itineraries.title: Zanzibar 5 nights + Muscat 3 nights

stops.hotel: Nungwi Dreams by Mantis — the Presidential Villa is the ONLY unit that sleeps 5 on one booking; there is no 2-bedroom or connecting unit on sale
stops.basis: dated rate, Google Hotels, nightly GBP 1,735 including breakfast

stops.hotel: InterContinental Muscat — two City View Balcony rooms (3+2 adults), one booking
stops.basis: dated rate: GBP 2,120-2,832 for 8 nights B&B

itineraries.flight_shape: open-jaw into Zanzibar and home from Muscat, with Muscat as the routing point rather than a separate ticket. Costed on the dated London-Muscat-Zanzibar routing, which OVER-states an open-jaw.
itineraries.cost_basis: three dated lines of four: the routing fare for 5, the villa (GBP 1,735 x 5) and the Muscat rooms.
itineraries.why: the only December option with a real beach, and 3 of its 4 lines are dated
itineraries.catch: the villa books a year ahead, and Nungwi rates 4.4
